WITH account_by_state AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_county_province,
    COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(account_count) as total_accounts,
    COUNT(*) as num_states
  FROM account_by_state
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    abs.state_county_province,
    abs.account_count,
    CAST(abs.account_count AS DECIMAL) / t.total_accounts as share,
    CAST(1.0 / t.num_states AS DECIMAL) as avg_share_value
  FROM account_by_state abs
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    account_count,
    share,
    avg_share_value,
    share - avg_share_value as excess
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > avg_share_value
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
